[comment by TheIllusiveC4 (owner)]
This crash is coming from one of the mixins in the Inventorio mod.

@Mo9713 The difference between 5.12.0 and 5.12.1 were very minor and would not be related to the cause of this issue. If you're seeing a similar error, please share the exact crash log from the instance.
